source.description:
PROBLEM
unitAI-rrdnt.48 added an inline 'contract' parameter to the Pi frontend's specialist_dispatch: either bead_id or contract, exactly one, both refused rather than resolved by preference. The MCP frontend (src/tools/specialist/activation.tool.ts) still requires bead_id and has no contract parameter at all. A coordinator's dispatch call is therefore not portable between the two surfaces, and the friction .48 was filed to remove is removed on only one of them.

Found by the phase12-docs lane while documenting .48, verified at 3b2a2611. It documented the delta rather than the shape, which was the right call for a doc but leaves the product question open.

SUCCESS
Either MCP accepts an inline contract on the same terms as Pi — same gate, run BEFORE any bead is created, both-or-neither refused — or the asymmetry is deliberate and documented as such with its reason.

SCRUTINY
LOW

SCOPE
src/tools/specialist/activation.tool.ts and its schema. The readiness gate and createBeadFromContract already exist and are exported through the lib seam; this is wiring, not new mechanism.

NON_GOALS
Does not change the Pi frontend. Does not change the gate. Does not relax the requirement that a refused dispatch leaves the board unchanged.

CONSTRAINTS
This is a PRODUCT decision before it is an implementation: MCP's bead_id-only shape may be intentional, since the MCP coordinator is Claude Code and has the bd CLI available directly, while the Pi coordinator may not. Decide that first.
If MCP follows, it must reuse the SAME extractSections/evaluateBeadReadiness path — a second gate would let the two frontends disagree about admission, which is the failure this epic has spent the day removing.

VALIDATION
Either an MCP dispatch with an inline contract is admitted and creates its bead, or the doc states the asymmetry and why.

OUTPUT
The parameter and its tests, or a documented decision.

REFERENCES
unitAI-rrdnt.48 (the Pi implementation), unitAI-rrdnt.32 (the doc that found it), unitAI-rrdnt.54 (the same-line format both frontends now accept).
source.notes:
DEFERRED by operator decision 2026-09-08. MCP is not the Pi coordinator's path — it is for Claude and non-pi agents, and will follow the newer (0728) MCP protocol. Bringing the MCP frontend to parity with a Pi-only convenience is the wrong direction while that migration is pending.

FOR THE RECORD, since this bead was filed as a parity gap: the PRD's MCP obligation is MET. Phase 13 says 'Expose the same native activation runtime through MCP. No CLI shell-out.' — closed as unitAI-rrdnt.33. Inline contracts arrived later on the Pi side via unitAI-rrdnt.48, so this is post-PRD drift between two frontends, not an unmet requirement. Deferring costs nothing against the PRD.

This is also continuous with unitAI-rrdnt.10, which already demoted MCP as the Claude transport after finding Claude Code's MCP CLIENT lacks sampling/createMessage, ignores resources/subscribe, and discards logging notifications — the peer/roster adapter was promoted to primary for exactly that reason.

REOPEN WHEN: the 0728 protocol migration lands and the question becomes what the MCP surface should look like for non-pi agents, rather than whether it should mirror Pi.
source.title: MCP specialist_dispatch has no contract parameter, so dispatch calls are not portable between frontends
